title: Media Conglomeration, Local News, and Capital Market Consequences
eligible_reason: Stacked event-study design. Each of 143 Sinclair station acquisitions (event id obs, 12 distinct event quarters 2012Q1-2017Q3) defines an 8-quarter window (diff = -4..+3); treated firms (affected==1, HQ in the acquired station's DMA) and control firms (neighbouring DMAs, assigned the same event date) are stacked, 417 of 736 firms appear in several events, and the regressions use firm-by-event FE (obsd = group(obs permno)) and calendar-quarter FE with c.post##c.affected (reghdfe Y c.post##c.affected, a(obsd yearqtr) vce(cluster dma_code)). The protocol excludes stacked DiD. The station-level transcript regressions (Table 4) use only treated stations, station FE and a post indicator with no calendar-time FE, and the DMA-level selection tests use event x DMA FE only.
design_notes: Firm-level panels (firm_main_panel.dta: 27,404 firm-event-quarters, 736 permnos, 143 events, yearqtr 2011Q1-2018Q2; firm_gsvi_panel.dta; firm_algo_panel.dta), investor panel (investor_main_panel.dta: mgrno-event-quarters), DMA demographic panel (demo_main_panel.dta), station transcript panels (transcript_sinclair_firm_panel.dta, transcript_sinclair_macro_panel.dta: station source x week yw). Main code 4. DLO_regression.do: Table 3A selection tests (firm characteristics on c.post##c.affected, a(obsd yearqtr)); Table 6 local_google_search; Table 7 local_port_bias; Table 8A retail_vol (each with cols: constant only, obsd+yearqtr FE, FE+decile-ranked controls); Table 8B algo-trading falsification; Table 9 cross-sectional triple interactions; Figure 2 relative-quarter interactions (c.post_2..c.post_8)##c.affected. Table 4: local_ratio and macro_coverage on post with station FE (source), cluster yw, treated stations only, controls in col 3. Cites Goodman-Bacon 2021, Baker-Larcker-Wang 2022, Cengiz et al. 2019 (stacked design).
estimators_reported: pre-post with station FE (no time FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Event quarters (diff==0) across 143 events: 2012Q1 (19), 2012Q2 (5), 2012Q4 (30), 2013Q1 (6), 2013Q2 (20), 2013Q3 (1), 2013Q4 (14), 2014Q3 (38), 2014Q4 (4), 2016Q1 (4), 2016Q2 (1), 2017Q3 (1). An unstacked firm-quarter TWFE could be constructed but is not what the paper reports.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design: firm-by-event FE (obsd) over 8-quarter event windows with control firms assigned the event date; post main effect included via c.post##c.affected
specs.treatment_definition: affected = firm HQ in a DMA with a Sinclair-acquired station; post = quarter >= event quarter (diff>=0), defined for treated and control firms of the same event
specs.sample_condition: e(sample) of the controls regression; diff in -4..3
specs.notes: Analogous specs: Table 6 col 2 (local_google_search, line 198, firm_gsvi_panel.dta), Table 7 col 2 (local_port_bias, line 314, investor_main_panel.dta, unit mgrno x event).
